change.problem: An idle foreground Operation coordinator allowed the deterministic fake resource observation to expire, so a later harmless local Task could be parked as no_route.
change.fix: Existing Operation maintenance_tick refreshes only an already-registered fake resource that has no quota domain, is available and healthy/degraded, and is not circuit-open.
change.authority: The existing Operation queue, routing, retry, approval, and reconciliation boundaries remain authoritative.

observed.regression_test: A stale 2020 observation was injected into fake:default before a new deterministic Task; the coordinator completed the Task after the maintenance refresh.

verification.compileall: python -m compileall -q src recovery scripts => PASS

limitations: This proves the local foreground runtime can remain useful after idle; it is not OS startup, Task Scheduler, Windows Service, or deployed Guardian evidence.
Real Provider quota and liveness observations are not refreshed by this deterministic fake-only path.
AR1 live recovery and Phase 8 single-root live activation remain separate roadmap work.
